items.exampleEn: A cat that rides the bus every day is quite newsworthy.
items.exampleZh: 一隻每天搭公車的貓相當有新聞價值。

items.exampleEn: The cursor on my screen keeps disappearing.
items.exampleZh: 我螢幕上的游標一直不見。

items.exampleEn: The anchorman made a small mistake during the live news and quickly apologized.
items.exampleZh: 那位男主播在新聞直播時出了個小錯，很快就道歉了。

items.exampleEn: You can save the file with a single keystroke.
items.exampleZh: 你只要按一個鍵就能儲存檔案。

items.exampleEn: Today's phones are far more powerful than the first microcomputers.
items.exampleZh: 現在的手機比最早的微電腦強大得多。

items.exampleEn: Many banks now offer paperless bills by email.
items.exampleZh: 現在很多銀行提供用電子郵件寄送的無紙化帳單。

items.exampleEn: The station is looking for a new anchorperson for its morning show.
items.exampleZh: 電視台正在為晨間節目找一位新主播。

items.sentenceEn: Move the cursor to the top of the page and click the red button.
items.sentenceZh: 把游標移到頁面最上方，然後點擊紅色按鈕。

items.audioEn: Our school went paperless, so all homework is now sent online.
items.audioZh: 我們學校改成無紙化，所以現在所有作業都在網路上繳交。
options: Through the internet, not on paper
On paper at the school office

items.sentenceEn: The anchorperson smiled and said good evening to everyone at home.
items.sentenceZh: 主播微笑著向在家收看的每個人說晚安。

items.sentenceEn: Every keystroke on this old keyboard makes a loud noise.
items.sentenceZh: 在這個舊鍵盤上每按一個鍵都會發出很大的聲音。

items.stemEn: The reporter decided the story was not ____ enough to be on the evening news.
items.stemZh: 記者認為這則故事的新聞價值還不夠上晚間新聞。

items.stemEn: Before laptops, many offices used a ____ to write reports.
items.stemZh: 在筆記型電腦出現以前，很多辦公室用微電腦寫報告。

items.passageEn: For thirty years, Mr. Chen was the anchorman of the evening news on a local TV station. When he started, the office was full of paper, and reporters typed their stories on noisy machines. In 1984, the station bought its first microcomputers, and he still remembers the sound of every keystroke. Today, the office is completely paperless: reporters share stories on screens, and the anchorperson reads from a screen in front of the camera. Mr. Chen says the biggest change of the last few decades is speed. A newsworthy event can be online within minutes, but he worries that some reports are now written too quickly.
items.passageZh: 陳先生在一家地方電視台當了三十年的晚間新聞主播。他剛開始工作時，辦公室裡到處都是紙，記者用很吵的機器打新聞稿。一九八四年，電視台買了第一批微電腦，他到現在還記得每次敲鍵盤的聲音。如今，辦公室已經完全無紙化：記者在螢幕上分享新聞稿，主播看著鏡頭前的螢幕播報。陳先生說，過去幾十年最大的改變是速度。一件有新聞價值的事幾分鐘內就能上網，但他擔心現在有些報導寫得太快了。

questions.questionZh: 陳先生剛開始工作時，辦公室是什麼樣子？
陳先生認為最大的改變是什麼？
options: 電視台的主播換了很多次

items.promptZh: 這場會議是無紙化的，所有資料都在我們的手機上。
referenceEn: This meeting is paperless; all the documents are on our phones.
The meeting is paperless, so all the documents are on our phones.
rubricZh: paperless 的用法，例如 a paperless meeting、the meeting is paperless 等
「所有資料都在手機上」可寫，例如 all the documents are on our phones 等

items.instructionZh: 用 newsworthy 造一個句子，說說你覺得最近有什麼事值得上新聞。
referenceEn: I think the new night market in my town is newsworthy.
The opening of the new bridge in my city was really newsworthy.
rubricZh: newsworthy 可放在 be 動詞後或名詞前（例如 is newsworthy、a newsworthy event 等）
時態配合內容（例如 is、was 等）
